title: Convolution Skew-$t$ Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2610.41171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the convolution skew-$t$ (CST) distribution, which combines independent standardized skew-$t$ subvectors through a general loading matrix to accommodate heterogeneous tails, directional asymmetry, and non-elliptical dependence. We establish identification and develop likelihood inference using analytical scores and a one-dimensional reduction of Fisher information. For the finite-variance model, we prove consistency and asymptotic normality of maximum likelihood and characterize the consequences of imposing false symmetry. A raw representation extends the family to all positive tail indices. Simulations assess finite-sample performance, and a realized-volatility application illustrates the empirical value of allowing tail thickness and asymmetry to vary across latent subvectors.

translated_abstract: 我们提出了卷积偏斜-$t$（CST）分布，该分布通过一个一般性的载荷矩阵将相互独立的标准化的偏斜-$t$子向量组合起来，以刻画异质的尾部行为、方向性不对称以及非椭圆的依赖结构。我们建立了该模型的可识别性，并利用解析形式的得分函数和费希尔信息矩阵的一维约简发展了似然推断方法。对于有限方差模型，我们证明了极大似然估计的相合性与渐近正态性，并刻画了错误地施加对称性约束所导致的后果。通过一种原始表示（raw representation），该分布族被扩展到所有正的尾部指数。模拟研究评估了有限样本下的表现，而已实现波动率的实证应用则展示了允许尾部厚度和不对称性在不同潜在子向量之间变化的实证价值。
tldr: 本文提出卷积偏斜-$t$（CST）分布，通过载荷矩阵组合独立的标准化偏斜-$t$子向量，以刻画异质尾部、方向性不对称和非椭圆依赖，并建立了其识别性与极大似然估计的渐近理论，且在已实现波动率应用中证实了其实证价值。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the convolution skew-$t$ (CST) distribution, which combines independent standardized skew-$t$ subvectors via a general loading matrix to capture heterogeneous tails, directional asymmetry, and non-elliptical dependence, establishing identification, asymptotic theory for maximum likelihood, and empirical value in realized-volatility applications.
